description:
## Why

Subset of PKIX-l63j epic. The lowest-risk, no-new-deps step toward RFC 4518 DN normalization.

Currently `pkix-path/src/lib.rs` `any_to_str_bytes` returns `None` for BMPString/UniversalString/TeletexString tags, falling back to raw DER byte equality in `ava_values_match`. Two certs that encode the same logical string with different DER tags (e.g. UTF8String 'Foo Co' vs BMPString 'Foo Co' as UCS-2) compare unequal even though they represent the same Unicode codepoints.

Investigation findings (PKIX-l63j parent task subagent):
- `der` 0.7.10 already provides `der::asn1::BmpString` with a `chars()` iterator. No new deps needed.
- `der` 0.7.10 does NOT recognise UniversalString (tag 0x1C is absent from `Tag::try_from`). Certs with UniversalString AVAs already fail `Certificate::from_der` upstream and never reach `ava_values_match`. UniversalString handling is therefore parser-rejected and need not be implemented in this child.
- TeletexString is already partially handled (treated as ASCII / Latin-1 by existing `any_to_str_bytes` callers); RFC 4518 §1.6 says T.61 transcoding is implementation-defined. Out of scope for this child; covered by separate child.
- Zero existing PKITS or in-tree fixtures use BMPString DN AVAs. New synthetic fixtures must be generated via OpenSSL or pyca/cryptography.

## What

1. Refactor `NormalizedIter` from `Iterator<Item = u8>` to `Iterator<Item = char>`. ASCII-only inputs behave identically (case-fold via `char::to_ascii_lowercase`, whitespace collapse via `ch == ' '`).
2. Replace `fn any_to_str_bytes(a: &der::Any) -> Option<&[u8]>` with `fn any_to_chars(a: &der::Any) -> Option<impl Iterator<Item = char>>` (or equivalent shape that fits the call site). Dispatch:
   - `Utf8String`: `str::from_utf8(.value()).ok().map(str::chars)`
   - `PrintableString`/`Ia5String`/`VisibleString`: ASCII subset; map bytes to char
   - `BmpString`: decode via `der::asn1::BmpString` and call `chars()`. Reject odd-length content (malformed UCS-2) by returning `None` (fail-closed; existing pattern for malformed strings).
3. Update `ava_values_match` and `normalized_eq` to consume `char` iterators.
4. Update the existing 8 unit tests at `tests_normalized_iter` to construct `char` iterators (the public API doesn't change shape, the internal fn signatures do).
5. Add new tests:
   - BMPString-encoded 'Foo Co' compares equal to UTF8String 'Foo Co' (positive).
   - BMPString-encoded 'foo co' compares equal to UTF8String 'Foo Co' under case folding (positive, ASCII case fold).
   - BMPString-encoded 'Bar Co' compares unequal to UTF8String 'Foo Co' (negative).
   - Synthetic test fixture: build two `Name` values via x509-cert constructors, one with PrintableString CN and one with BMPString CN, both 'TestCA'; assert `names_match` returns true.
6. Update doc comments at `lib.rs:22-31` and `lib.rs:144-149` to reflect what's now supported (BMPString same-Unicode-codepoints) vs what remains a limitation (no NFKC, no full RFC 4518 prep, UniversalString parser-rejected).

## Acceptance

- [ ] BMPString-encoded same-Unicode CN matches UTF8String CN under existing case-fold + whitespace rules
- [ ] All existing PKITS DN tests still pass (ASCII-only behaviour unchanged)
- [ ] no_std preserved, no new dependencies
- [ ] Limitation docs updated to reflect new state
- [ ] Synthetic BMPString test fixture committed (in-process construction via x509-cert types, no openssl shell-out)

## Out of scope (covered by sibling children of PKIX-l63j)

- Unicode NFKC / case-fold for non-ASCII characters
- Full RFC 4518 6-step prep pipeline
- TeletexString policy decision
- UniversalString (parser-rejected; document only)
- Foreign-language DN test corpus expansion (separate child)
title: pkix-path: BMPString transcoding + char-based NormalizedIter (no NFKC)
